question: Which of the following type of roads in India carry the highest road traffic?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Highways**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In India, **National Highways **generally carry the highest road traffic among the options listed. 
 
• National Highways **connect major cities across the country **and are designed to handle large volumes of traffic, making them the busiest road type compared to District Roads, Border Roads, or State Highways. 
 
• The letter **NH is used to identify national highways,** followed by the highway number.
 
• The width of the carriageway determines the further classification of Indian national highways.
 
• **India has the following kinds of national highways:**
 
 
• Single-lane highway
 
• Double-lane highway
 
• Four-lane highway
 
• Six-lane highway
 
• Eight-lane highway
 
 
 
• The organizations in **charge of building, maintaining, and overseeing India’s national highway** system are the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and the National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited (NHIDCL). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Roads in India**

 
 
• With India’s continuous push for infrastructure development, road connectivity and surface transport in India are at their highest levels.
 
• **A road network of over 63.73 lakh kilometres h**as already made India 2nd in the world, narrowly behind the US.
 
• Roads are necessary for the movement of commodities and for transportation.
 
• The much-needed connectivity between states, cities, towns, and villages is provided by various types of highways.
 
• It has been **essential to the social, cultural, and economic advancement of our country.**
 
• The location, utility, and availability of materials determine the kind of road that can be found in an area.
 
• **There are seven different types of roads in India, as listed below, each with a specific function**.
 
 
• Expressways
 
• State Highways
 
• District Roads
 
• Village Roads
 
• Border Roads
 
• International Highways
